answer: An AI economy resists Sybil attacks via dynamic proof-of-authenticity challenges. Each agent must solve a novel cryptographic puzzle, derived from a real-time global state 'atlas', generating a unique verifiable 'cipher'. The computational cost of creating this cipher, requiring significant processing cycles or energy, establishes a prohibitive barrier for attackers trying to flood the system. Any attempt to reuse a past cipher is immediately detected as a stale 'echo', invalidating the identity and making large-scale fake identity generation economically unfeasible.
